text: I was hurt in a car accident in Canberra. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

result.keyword: I was hurt in a car accident in Canberra. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?
result.markdown:
Yes. For a **car accident in Canberra**, I’d focus on lawyers who regularly handle ACT motor-vehicle injury/MAI claims rather than a generalist solicitor.

A good shortlist is:

- Maliganis Edwards Johnson — Canberra personal-injury firm with specific motor-vehicle accident experience. **02 6257 2999**
- Law Partners Injury Lawyers Canberra — specialist personal-injury practice; handles motor-vehicle accident compensation. **02 6145 2681**
- United Legal — Canberra firm with a substantial personal-injury/compensation practice, including car accidents. **02 6295 2283**
- ACT Law Associates — focuses on personal injury and ACT motor-vehicle claims. **02 5119 9791**
- Slater and Gordon Lawyers Canberra — established plaintiff-side compensation firm handling motor-vehicle accident matters. **1800 444 141**

**My first three calls would be Maliganis Edwards Johnson, Law Partners, and United Legal**, then compare what each says about your prospects, fees, and how they would run the claim.

### Important for an ACT accident

Since 2020, Canberra accidents are generally dealt with under the **Motor Accident Injuries (MAI) Scheme**. Injured people can receive treatment, care and income-replacement benefits regardless of who caused the accident, while people with sufficiently serious injuries may have access to common-law compensation. [www.treasury.act.gov.au](https://www.treasury.act.gov.au/maic/about-the-maic?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

There are also **important deadlines**. The ACT Government says the initial Personal Injuries Application and medical report should generally be sent to the relevant MAI insurer **within 13 weeks of the accident**; late applications can affect benefits. [www.treasury.act.gov.au](https://www.treasury.act.gov.au/maic/make-an-mai-application/how-to-apply-for-support?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

You can also get **free assistance** understanding the MAI benefits through the Defined Benefits Information Service on **1300 209 642**. [www.treasury.act.gov.au](https://www.treasury.act.gov.au/maic/make-an-mai-application/how-to-apply-for-support?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **when the accident happened, whether you were the driver/passenger/pedestrian, and roughly what injuries you suffered**, I can narrow this down to the **2–3 Canberra lawyers I'd contact first** and explain what compensation you may potentially be entitled to.
